<style>
.logo{line-height:1!important;display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;min-width:210px}.logo small{font:950 10px/1 system-ui!important;letter-spacing:.32em!important;color:#fff!important;margin:0 0 -1px!important}.logo b{display:none!important}.brewers-wordmark{width:210px;height:48px;object-fit:contain;display:block}.mark,.opp{border:0!important;background:transparent!important}.teamSiteLogo{width:64px;height:64px;object-fit:contain;display:block;margin:auto;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 8px #0008)}.leagueGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:7px}.leagueTeam{display:grid;grid-template-columns:42px 1fr;gap:8px;align-items:center;background:#071a2b;border:1px solid #27465f;border-radius:11px;padding:8px}.leagueTeam img{width:40px;height:40px;object-fit:contain}.leagueTeam b{font-size:10px;line-height:1.1;display:block}.leagueTeam small{color:#8ea5b8;font-size:9px}.profileTop{display:grid;grid-template-columns:68px 1fr 52px;gap:10px;align-items:center}.profileTop .bigAv{width:66px;height:66px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid #d2a01c;background:#163957;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:18px;font-weight:950}.profileTop h2{font-size:23px;margin:0;line-height:1.05}.profileTop p{margin:4px 0 0;color:#8ea5b8;font-size:10px}.profileLogo{width:50px;height:50px;object-fit:contain}.contactGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:7px}.contactBox{background:#071a2b;border:1px solid #27465f;border-radius:10px;padding:9px}.contactBox b{font-size:10px;display:block}.contactBox span{font-size:9px;color:#8ea5b8;display:block;margin-top:3px}.profileActions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:6px;margin:8px 0}.profileActions button{background:#0a2035;color:#fff;border:1px solid #31516a;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 2px;font-size:9px;font-weight:900}.profileChart{height:105px;background:#071a2b;border:1px solid #27465f;border-radius:10px;padding:8px}.profileChart svg{width:100%;height:100%}.tinyStats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:6px}.tinyStat{background:#071a2b;border:1px solid #27465f;border-radius:10px;text-align:center;padding:8px 3px}.tinyStat b{display:block;font-size:18px}.tinyStat small{color:#8ea5b8;font-size:8px}.teamLogoFallback{width:50px;height:50px;border:1px solid #36536b;border-radius:12px;display:none;place-items:center;font-size:10px;font-weight:950;margin:auto}
</style>
<script>
(()=>{
const WM='data:image/webp;base64,';
const LOGOS={
'Archangels':'https://www.granitestatebaseball.com/photos/baseball/GRANITEST-ARCHANGELS/teamIcon.png',
'Granite State Grizzlies':'https://www.granitestatebaseball.com/photos/baseball/GRANITESTATEGRIZZLIE1/teamIcon.png',
'Lakes Region Muskrats':'https://www.granitestatebaseball.com/photos/baseball/LAKESREGIONMUSKRATS/teamIcon.png',
'Meredith MudDucks':'https://www.granitestatebaseball.com/photos/baseball/GRA-MEREDITHMUDDUCKS/teamIcon.png',
'Merrimack Brewers':'https://www.granitestatebaseball.com/photos/baseball/GRA-MERRIMACKBREWERS/teamIcon.png',
'Merrimack Valley Redbirds':'https://www.granitestatebaseball.com/photos/baseball/MERRIMACKVALLEYREDBI/teamIcon.png',
'Nashua Rockies':'https://www.granitestatebaseball.com/photos/baseball/GRANIT-NASHUAROCKIES/teamIcon.png',
'New Hampshire Bucks':'https://www.granitestatebaseball.com/photos/baseball/NEWHAMPSHIREBUCKS/teamIcon.png',
'Northeast Huskies':'https://www.granitestatebaseball.com/photos/baseball/GRA-NORTHEASTHUSKIES/teamIcon.png',
'Raphael Club Black Sox':'https://www.granitestatebaseball.com/photos/baseball/RAPHAELCLUBBLACKSOX1/teamIcon.png'};
const TEAMS=[['Northeast Huskies','13-2-1'],['Nashua Rockies','13-2-1'],['New Hampshire Bucks','13-2-1'],['Raphael Club Black Sox','9-6-1'],['Merrimack Valley Redbirds','9-7'],['Meredith MudDucks','6-9-1'],['Lakes Region Muskrats','6-10'],['Granite State Grizzlies','4-11-1'],['Merrimack Brewers','4-12'],['Archangels','0-16']];
const li=n=>`<img class="teamSiteLogo" src="${LOGOS[n]||''}" alt="${n} logo" onerror="this.style.display='none';this.nextElementSibling.style.display='grid'"><span class="teamLogoFallback">${n.split(' ').map(x=>x[0]).slice(0,2).join('')}</span>`;
const logo=document.querySelector('.logo');if(logo)logo.innerHTML=`<small>MERRIMACK</small><img class="brewers-wordmark" src="${WM}" alt="Merrimack Brewers">`;
for(let i=roster.length-1;i>=0;i--){if(roster[i][1]==='Nolan Haberer'||roster[i][1]==='Steve Crow')roster.splice(i,1)}
window.game=function(id){const el=document.getElementById(id);if(!el)return;el.innerHTML=`<div class="row"><span class="pill g">DEMO RSVP</span><span class="pill r">FIELD / TIME UPDATED</span></div><div class="team"><div>${li('Merrimack Brewers')}<div class="tn">MERRIMACK<br>BREWERS</div><div class="rec">4–12</div></div><div class="vs">VS</div><div>${li(st.game.opp)}<div class="tn">${esc(st.game.opp).toUpperCase()}</div><div class="rec">Granite State 21s</div></div></div><div class="meta"><div><small>Date / time</small><b>${esc(st.game.date)} · ${esc(st.game.time)}</b></div><div><small>Field</small><b>${esc(st.game.field)}</b></div></div><div class="k">Who’s coming?</div><div class="rsvp"><button class="${st.rsvp==='going'?'sel':''}" onclick="rsvp('going')"><b style="color:var(--green)">${st.going}</b>GOING</button><button class="${st.rsvp==='maybe'?'sel':''}" onclick="rsvp('maybe')"><b style="color:var(--gold)">${st.maybe}</b>MAYBE</button><button class="${st.rsvp==='out'?'sel':''}" onclick="rsvp('out')"><b style="color:var(--red)">${st.out}</b>OUT</button><button class="${st.rsvp==='none'?'sel':''}" onclick="rsvp('none')"><b>${st.none}</b>NO REPLY</button></div>`};
window.profile=function(i){const p=roster[i],has=p[6],ini=p[1].split(' ').map(x=>x[0]).slice(0,2).join('');mc.innerHTML=`<div class="profileTop"><div class="bigAv">${ini}</div><div><h2>${esc(p[1])} ${p[0]?'#'+p[0]:''}</h2><p>${esc(p[2]||'Position not listed')} · B ${p[3]||'—'} / T ${p[4]||'—'}</p></div>${li('Merrimack Brewers')}</div><div class="k">Contact</div><div class="contactGrid"><div class="contactBox"><b>Phone</b><span>Not added yet</span></div><div class="contactBox"><b>Email</b><span>Not added yet</span></div><div class="contactBox"><b>Emergency contact</b><span>Private · player managed</span></div><div class="contactBox"><b>Preferred contact</b><span>Team chat / text</span></div></div><div class="profileActions"><button onclick="closeM();go('chat')">💬 Message</button><button>📞 Contact</button><button>⭐ Follow</button></div><div class="k">2026 Stats</div>${has?`<div class="tinyStats"><div class="tinyStat"><b>${p[6]}</b><small>AVG</small></div><div class="tinyStat"><b>${p[7]||'—'}</b><small>OBP</small></div><div class="tinyStat"><b>${p[8]||'—'}</b><small>OPS</small></div><div class="tinyStat"><b>${p[5]||'—'}</b><small>GAMES</small></div></div>`:`<div class="notice">No player stat row loaded yet. This is ready for website/GameChanger sync later.</div>`}<div class="k">Last 7 Games</div><div class="profileChart"><svg viewBox="0 0 260 100" preserveAspectRatio="none"><line x1="10" y1="88" x2="250" y2="88" stroke="#294963"/><polyline fill="none" stroke="#ffbd19" stroke-width="3" points="10,70 50,77 90,48 130,66 170,44 210,64 250,32"/><g fill="#ffbd19"><circle cx="10" cy="70" r="3"/><circle cx="50" cy="77" r="3"/><circle cx="90" cy="48" r="3"/><circle cx="130" cy="66" r="3"/><circle cx="170" cy="44" r="3"/><circle cx="210" cy="64" r="3"/><circle cx="250" cy="32" r="3"/></g></svg></div><div class="k">Availability</div><div class="tinyStats"><div class="tinyStat"><b>82%</b><small>RSVP RATE</small></div><div class="tinyStat"><b>14</b><small>GOING</small></div><div class="tinyStat"><b>3</b><small>MAYBE</small></div><div class="tinyStat"><b>2</b><small>OUT</small></div></div><div class="k">Team Activity</div><div class="notice">Manager Kevin Hascall: Great work last game. Keep it rolling.</div>`;modal.classList.add('on')};
const leaders=document.querySelector('#home .leaders');if(leaders)leaders.innerHTML=`<div class="leader"><strong>1</strong><b>Foster St. Cyr</b><span>.342 AVG</span></div><div class="leader"><strong>2</strong><b>Anthony Hall</b><span>.340 AVG</span></div><div class="leader"><strong>3</strong><b>James Mancini</b><span>.326 AVG</span></div><div class="leader"><strong>4</strong><b>Matt Iandoli</b><span>.300 AVG</span></div><div class="leader"><strong>P</strong><b>Camden Guay</b><span>4.07 ERA · 36 K</span></div>`;
const home=document.getElementById('home');if(home&&!document.getElementById('leagueTeams'))home.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<div class="k">2026 Granite State 21s Teams</div><div id="leagueTeams" class="leagueGrid">${TEAMS.map(t=>`<div class="leagueTeam">${li(t[0])}<div><b>${t[0]}</b><small>${t[1]}</small></div></div>`).join('')}</div>`);
const schedule=document.getElementById('schedule');if(schedule){schedule.innerHTML=`<div class="title">Schedule</div><div class="sub">Official Brewers page currently shows no future games. These are app walkthrough events using current GSBL teams and their exact website logos.</div><div class="k">Featured Demo Game</div><div id="gameSched" class="card gold"></div><div class="k">Demo Upcoming Games</div><div class="card list" id="realLogoSched"></div>`;const games=[['SUN JUN 8','New Hampshire Bucks','11:00 AM'],['WED JUN 11','Lakes Region Muskrats','6:00 PM'],['SUN JUN 15','Meredith MudDucks','10:00 AM'],['WED JUN 18','Northeast Huskies','7:15 PM'],['SUN JUN 22','Raphael Club Black Sox','12:00 PM'],['WED JUN 25','Archangels','6:30 PM']];document.getElementById('realLogoSched').innerHTML=games.map(g=>`<div class="sched" style="grid-template-columns:48px 45px 1fr auto"><div><b>${g[0].split(' ').slice(1).join(' ')}</b><small>${g[0].split(' ')[0]}</small></div>${li(g[1])}<div><b>vs ${g[1]}</b><small>${g[2]} · Riverview Field</small></div><span class="pill">DEMO</span></div>`).join('')}
if(typeof st==='object'){st.ann='Field change: Tonight’s game moved to Riverview Field in Andover. Please arrive by 5:45 PM.';if(st.msgs?.[0])st.msgs[0][0]='Manager Kevin Hascall';save()}
render();
})();
</script>
